typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Cfg_BaseDirectory as string (),
	Cfg_RowDelimiter as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Column 0} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource split(left(Column 0, 6) != 'HEADER' && left(Column 0, 7) != 'TRAILER', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(DataRow,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@DataRow derive({Column 1} = replace(replace({Column 0}, toString('|'), toString(',')), toString(' '), toString(''))) ~> ReplacePipesandSpaces
ReplacePipesandSpaces derive({Column 1} = left({Column 1}, length({Column 1}) - 1)) ~> TrimLastPipe
TrimLastPipe sink(input(
		Column_1 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_1 = {Column 1})) ~> FlatFileDestination
